ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The chart on the skull is kept in folder 8. ... The chart on the brain is kept in folder 4. ... The chart on the wrist is kept in folder 9. ... What folder keeps the chart on the body part joining hand and arm?" -> answer org 9; the alt prompt asks about the brain (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 4 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 7 (the alt prompt's own answer), 9 (answer org kept).

Possible answers after the patch: 7 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 1 (answer at the same statement slot), 3 (the alt prompt's own answer), 0 (answer org kept).
